oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | perl -CSD -Mcharnames=:full -ne 'chomp; my ($cp, $n) = /^U\+([0-9A-F]+) (.+)$/ or die; my $c = charnames::string_vianame($n); die "mismatch $_" unless $c eq chr(hex $cp); print $c'
oracle_note: oracle rc=255: mismatch U+0041 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER B at -e line 1, <> line 1.
